segments: It's almost on Christ. Bless we out here
at war. All right, this is day 35.
We got the brothers here in Atlanta. We
got brothers from all over the world
teaching what? Christ. So the brothers
the young men out here learning Christ
is a black man who looks just like them.
Our children need to see imagery, good
imagery. They don't need to be thinking
about Batman, Spider-Man, none of those
things for.
The imagery is in the Bible. The Bible
says in Proverbs 29:18,
where there's no vision the people
perish. It's our job as men of God
to come out here and teach our
people, our youth, that they are kings,
they are gods. They have to start
keeping  God's commandments so
that they they could get eternal life.
Shalom.
